facts.fact: Pegeen 盘算两天后决定：带 Vedra 与 Daley 随她去 Crannhyr 的 Holy Mircha 大神庙朝圣，次日出发。
facts.anchor: declare that the children should come with her on pilgrimage

facts.fact: Pegeen 教给孩子的教义开头：初代 Mircha 是天神 Brynioch 的姐妹兼妻子，海是她的领域。
facts.anchor: the first Mircha had been sister and wife to great Brynioch

facts.fact: Mircha 亲口预言：女儿出生之时，她自己将不复存在。
facts.anchor: When my daughter is born, I will cease to be.

facts.fact: Vedra 逃得仓促，把 Pegeen 给的一笔铜板落在藏钱处，身上只剩第一笔酬金。
facts.anchor: The coppers that Pegeen gave us—I left them behind!

facts.fact: 朝圣第一夜宿在 Killro 的 Oymos 神庙，Daley 要买徽章，Vedra 花掉一枚铜板。
facts.anchor: Daley wanted a badge, and though Vedra knew

facts.fact: 林间空地两端各起一道火墙，把整支朝圣队困在路中间。
facts.anchor: a river of flame suddenly swept across the road

facts.fact: Flann 隔火喊话：路两侧林中各埋伏三十分（60）名弓手。
facts.anchor: there are three score of them on either side of you

facts.fact: 随行"修士"当场揭穿绑匪头目的身份：Flann Alderwood，强盗与杀手。
facts.anchor: You are Flann Alderwood, bandit and killer!

facts.fact: Flann 说明：Crannhyr 的里夫 Hagan 借这支朝圣队偷运 Hernysadharc 国库的银子。
facts.anchor: has used your pilgrimage to cloak a delivery of riches

facts.fact: 章末 Flann 转身走开，Vedra 发现 Daley 不见了。
